translations.web: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.
translations.bsb: He assumed his brothers would understand that God was using him to deliver them, but they did not.
translations.kjv: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
translations.asv: and he supposed that his brethren understood that God by his hand was giving them deliverance; but they understood not.
